messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty incident PDR-98321 fired for service=redwood-inference region=us-west-2 subject=GPU alloc failures (auto-severity=P2) :rotating_light:

pagerduty: Incident PDR-98321 has been triggered and is awaiting acknowledgment.

paul_oncall: acked PDR-98321 — i'm on it, checking dashboards now. seeing a big spike in cuda alloc errors across pool gpu-pool-3.

lina_sre: I'm taking this. pulling pod logs + nvml metrics. any customer-facing 5xx spikes?

paul_oncall: yes, hosted-api route /v1/generate 500-rate up ~6% from baseline. timelines match the alloc failures. latency also up a bit.

kai_eng: logs show repeated errors: `CUBLAS_STATUS_ALLOC_FAILED` and `cudaErrorMemoryAllocation` in the runtime logs. KV cache evictions are also very high.

jess_platform: auto-shedder has started to evict low-priority jobs in us-west-2, but we've still got several pods failing allocation during init.

lina_sre: plan: 1) identify failing nodes, 2) cordon + drain problematic nodes, 3) reroute new requests to us-west-1 and eu-west-1 while we stabilize, 4) increase retry/backoff for generator clients.

paul_oncall: good. i'll run a quick node query to list recent nvml OOMs.

kai_eng: paste from node metrics: ```
node-uw3-12: nvml_memory_total=48GB nvml_memory_free=~100MB nvml_evictions=72
node-uw3-15: nvml_memory_total=80GB nvml_memory_free=~50MB nvml_evictions=128
```

lina_sre: thanks. starting cordon on node-uw3-15 now.

paul_oncall: command I ran: ```
kubectl get pods -n infra -o wide --field-selector spec.nodeName=node-uw3-15 | awk '{print $1}' | xargs -r kubectl delete pod -n infra --grace-period=5
```

jess_platform: note: we have stateful workers with pinned caches — deleting pods will evict their caches and temporarily increase alloc pressure elsewhere. prefer evicting low-priority replica sets first.

lina_sre: acknowledged. using rollout pause + evict of batch jobs first. initiating rollout: ```
kubectl rollout pause deployment/rl-batch -n workloads
kubectl scale deployment/rl-batch -n workloads --replicas=0
```

paul_oncall: Traffic reroute is in progress: updated routing policy to prefer us-west-1,eu-west-1 for new requests. existing in-flight will still hit us-west-2.

incident-bot: PagerDuty note added: "Evacuating high-oom nodes, routing new traffic to other regions, pausing batch jobs. Monitoring for error rate to fall below 1.5%."

kai_eng: quick mitigation idea: bump host-side swap configuration temporarily and lower batch size for model worker to reduce peak allocations. Any objections?

lina_sre: do it for a short window. coordinate with platform to avoid long-term performance regressions. jess, can you apply a transient sysctl change?

jess_platform: applying swap/limits tweak now: ```
# transient: set swappiness and vm.overcommit
sudo sysctl -w vm.swappiness=60
sudo sysctl -w vm.overcommit_memory=1
```

paul_oncall: after draining node-uw3-15 and bumping swap, error rate dropped to 2.1% (was 6.3%). still above threshold but trending down.

lina_sre: moving to partial handoff — i'll stay on the thread for now. paul, if the error rate drops below 1.5% in 15m, we'll close PD and post RCA followup. otherwise escalate to SRE lead.

pagerduty: PDR-98321 acknowledged by paul_oncall and assigned to lina_sre.

kai_eng: found a pattern in model init: some model variants request large pinned allocations for KV cache, those pods are consistently failing on smaller GPU SKUs. we should adjust scheduler tolerations to avoid packing them onto older 48GB cards.

lina_sre: good catch. add a ticket to scheduler team to adjust binpacking policy (short-term: taint node groups, long-term: scheduler affinity rules).

paul_oncall: customers impacted: a subset of high-throughput tenants in us-west-2 saw increased error rates for ~18m. ops ran mitigation and reroutes; no data loss. notified customer-success to follow up.

jess_platform: customer-notify drafted and queued: "We experienced transient GPU allocation failures in us-west-2 which caused elevated 5xx rates for a portion of traffic. We've rerouted traffic and mitigations are in place; we're investigating root cause and will follow up with an RCA."

lina_sre: monitoring window 30m. i'll post interim update at +15m. starting to collect heap / nvml dumps for postmortem.

paul_oncall: thanks team. small checklist for RCA: node SKU mapping, model variant memory profiles, kvcache eviction metrics, scheduler pack decisions, auto-shedder thresholds.

incident-bot: PDR-98321 status changed to "monitoring".

lina_sre: interim update: error rate down to 1.3% — moving incident to monitoring and will close if stable. final follow-up to include mitigation timeline and suggested scheduler change. :white_check_mark:

paul_oncall: closing PD if stable in 10m. leaving notes for follow-up
